accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The row's text content, for an item with href (the link's name is everything inside it).
aria: sb-item-group host: role=list; sb-item inside it: role=listitem, both set when the element connects; an item moved in or out of a group gains or loses the listitem role it was given (an author role is never touched)
sb-item-separator: role=presentation, so a list has only listitem children
href: the whole row is one native link, so nested interactive controls should not be placed inside it
data-has-description and data-fixed are presentation-only attributes set by sb-item
accessibility.focusRingVisible: :focus-visible only; border and solid ring in item.focus-ring.color.
accessibility.role: none for a standalone item; listitem when its parent is sb-item-group; link when href is set (native a)
accessibility.targetSize: A linked item is at least as tall as its padding plus text (more than 24px).

openQuestions.question: List semantics: who is the list and who are the items?

href.note: Renders the whole row as a native link. Without it, or when empty, the row is a plain container. javascript:, vbscript: and data: URLs are dropped: the link renders without href and a console warning names it (SB-0115).

variant.note: primary: no surface. tertiary: bordered. muted: tinted surface (muted at half strength).

contract.summary: A flexible row for a piece of content with optional media, title, description and actions, usable alone, as a link, or in a list (a family of Web Components).

# Plan: Item (planning gate)

Status: Approved under SB-0011 (owner pre-approval, 2026-11-08).

## Scope
`sb-item` (variant, size, href) and ten parts: group, separator, media (variant primary|icon|image), content, title, description, actions, header, footer.

## Files (in build order)
| Step | File |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | `src/components/item/Item.stories.ts` |
| 2 | `playwright/tests/item/item.behavior.spec.ts` (written first, must fail) |
| 3 | `src/components/item/Item.scss` -> `Item.styles.ts` (generated, shared) |
| 4 | `Item.ts`, `ItemGroup.ts`, `ItemSeparator.ts`, `ItemMedia.ts`, `ItemContent.ts`, `ItemTitle.ts`, `ItemDescription.ts`, `ItemActions.ts`, `ItemHeader.ts`, `ItemFooter.ts`, `index.ts` |

## Tokens
`item.*` aliases semantic tokens (shared `space.stack.*`, `size.media.*`).

## Test plan (test-first)
- Layout, padding, gap, radius per variant and size; reflection; colors in light and dark.
- `href`: native link with a name, focus ring for keyboard only, hover tint, Enter follows; no link without href.
- Accessibility tree: group is a list whose semantic children are only listitems; standalone item has no role.
- Media frames; media alignment when a description exists; second content does not grow; header and footer span the row.
- Typography; links in the description; axe clean on all stories.

## Accessibility deviations from the references
- Solid 3px focus ring instead of a half-strength one.
- No two-line description clamp.
- Explicit list roles; presentational separator.

## Open questions
- Q1 Link row: answered, `href`.
- Q2 List semantics: answered, host roles.
- Q3 Description clamp: answered, dropped.
- Q4 Second content block: answered, `data-fixed`.
